2110715848629395657.en_summary: @munster_gene: as Apple adds AI across products, the goalposts move to personalized bots; on the Nov 2 earnings call he will listen for a Muse and Grok bot competitor. $AAPL got test approval for AI Siri in China, earlier than his mid 2027 expectation.
